To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the development problems of SMEs can be overcome by enhancing their capabilities.
SMEs that experienced development problems can overcome them and continue innovating by improving their capabilities.

“SMEs can continue innovating after delays or abandonment by improving their capabilities, which can be acquired through collaboration with external partners, non-techno-logical innovation and previous innovation”.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following research questions: (1) How can SME overcome failure?
the development of new products and services and the factors that contribute to the success or failure of innovation project.
the development of new products or services and the factors that influence the continuation of innovation projects in SMEs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the more capabilities a firm has, the less likely it will be that the innovation project is delayed or abandoned.
the capability development can compensate for resource limitations and thus help overcome the development difficulties.
the development of new products is not as dependent on resources as the development of new service is.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SMEs that experienced delays or abandonments in their innovation projects are more likely to continue innovating if they improve their capabilities.
in order to overcome failures, SMEs should improve their capabilities.
the development of innovation projects in SMEs is not a linear process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SMEs should be more active in acquiring new capabilities and that this is more important for service innovations than for product innovations.

in order to improve the efficiency of their innovation process and to reduce the occurrence of development problems SMEs can improve their capabilities by collaborating with partners or by investing in non-technological innovations.
SMEs should not only be aware of the risk of failure, but also be ready to learn how to overcome it.
